newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Speculators drive Sri Lanka rupee to low close.
newsitem.headline: Speculators drive Sri Lanka rupee to low close.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed slightly down against the dollar on Wednesday largely due to speculation fuelled by the U.S. currency's overseas gains, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.86 after opening at 57.84. Highest business done was at 57.92 before sellers moved in, brokers said.
"The market was driven by speculation," a Commercial Bank dealer said. "Internationally the dollar is bullish. The speculation was in response to that."
A Standard Chartered Bank dealer said trade-backed transactions were limited and speculators mostly bought dollars.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by 4.25 local cents, fixing buying and selling rates at 57.0502 and 58.2028.
Overnight call money, closed at 12.5 percent after opening at 13 percent and moving in a tight range during the day.
